mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 65 degree temperatures with overcast skies at Verona City Hall, a waxing crescent moon, an overnight low of 58 degrees, and no rain predicted.

City officials released a report covering calls for service from August 31 to September 14, highlighting various incidents including arrests for O W I and domestic battery, alongside a serious burglary case.

Tonight, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the lineup includes yoga at Insight Wellness, the Downtown Farmer's Market, more trivia, and pizza night at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
On September 10, officers responded to a burglary on Hunters Cove Way where a shot was fired, resulting in the successful detention of the suspect and the recovery of a handgun.
The Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a remodel, so enjoy your evening knowing you can visit when they open tomorrow at 10 AM to check out the next flavor of the day.
